title: 2026-11-05: After a save and reload there is no suggested in-memory copy

sections.name: narrative
sections.content:
in srs-web when I have loaded a repo into memory, it shows that the repo is already loaded if it has unsaved changes. 

But If I save, and then happen to reload - there is no suggested in-memory copy. 
Is the copy still in memory?
